notes: Jobs now also lists your jobs started outside the app (for example with sbatch in a terminal), read from Slurm: the last 7 days by default, up to a year, with their state, resources, folder and output, and you can cancel them. A COMSOL run now counts as finished only when COMSOL's log says it finished: a run that stops early (for example when the connection to the license server is lost) shows "Did not finish" or "Stopped: license lost" with where it stopped, instead of "Finished", and a notice tells you on any page. A Job log button beside Download results opens the job's log and keeps it updating, and the log window can search the file (Ctrl+F). COMSOL is now told how many cores Slurm gave the job, and a new opt-in setting under Advanced lets COMSOL use a batch license (off by default). Not code-signed yet.
